title: Lunar dust prevented a fourth EVA for Apollo astronauts

tellings.quote: The dust was uh um was very problematic for the Apollo astronauts where they couldn't even do a fourth EVA.

plain: Charles Buer, speaking as a witness on Jesse Michels's podcast, passes on what he says he was told about the Apollo Moon landings of 1969 to 1972. According to Buer, the Moon's dust caused the astronauts so much trouble that they could not do a fourth EVA, meaning a fourth trip outside the lander to work on the surface. He brings it up as an example of how hard the Moon's surface is to work on.
